scheme_name: Tagore National Fellowship for Cultural Research
other_conditions: Fellows must have sound academic or professional credentials with significant contributions in their field
Preferably at least 5 years of experience in conducting or guiding research or in performing/other arts
Must have at least two single‑authored monographs (publications)
Should have a strong reputation in the area covered by the chosen Nodal Institution
Applicants who have previously engaged with major projects at the Nodal Institution are encouraged to apply
A candidate who has received a Tagore National Fellowship cannot apply again for the scheme, either at the same or any other institution
The proportion of foreign nationals among awardees should not normally exceed one‑third of the total fellowships in a year
Applicants must be able to devote approximately two years to the research project
benefits_summary: Offers a high honorarium equivalent to the fellow's parent organization salary, along with allowances, contingency grant, housing support, and research infrastructure.
documents_required: Research proposal prepared as per Appendix A guidelines
Short write‑up on how the proposed research will benefit the Nodal Institution
Declaration stating the candidate will complete the full tenure of the Fellowship
